title: Egyptian Chicken Shawarma
description: A flavorful and spicy Egyptian-inspired street food. Marinated chicken is grilled to perfection and served in a crispy flatbread with your choice of toppings.

ingredients.name: Egyptian Spices
ingredients.notes: mix of cumin, coriander, paprika, and cayenne pepper

instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together zesty mayo, hummus, and Egyptian spices. Add the chicken breast and marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Preheat grill to medium-high heat. Remove chicken from marinade and cook for 5-7 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Warm flatbread by wrapping it in foil and heating it in the oven for 5 minutes.
Assemble shawarma by slicing the grilled chicken and serving it in the flatbread with your choice of toppings.
